title: Desk screening of building exposure to wadi channels in Muhayil Asir

headline.label: buildings screened, 71 in the high class

service.name: Flood Exposure Screening for Land and Sites

data: NASADEM_HGT version 001 by NASA JPL (2020): 1 arc-second (about 30 m) elevations from the SRTM flight of February 2000, in whole metres above the EGM96 geoid, tiles n18e041 and n18e042.
method: Read an 85 × 75 km window (EPSG:32638, x 160000 to 245000, y 2015000 to 2090000) covering the mountains that drain to the town, and reprojected it to 30 m cells.
Filled depressions by priority flood, derived D8 flow direction and accumulation, and checked that the catchments draining to the town's channels do not touch the window edge.
Wadi channel: every cell draining 5 km² or more.
Classes: high = 2 m or less above the channel and within 100 m of it; medium = 5 m or less and within 300 m; low = the rest.
limits: This is a desk screening, not a flood study or a hydrology study: there is no rainfall, discharge, depth or return period, it is not submitted to any authority for plan or building approval, and the study must be prepared and signed by a qualified office. The NASADEM user guide (NASA JPL, 2020) gives the SRTM requirement as 16 m absolute vertical error at 90% and a global average absolute height error of about 6.8 m, larger than the 2 m and 5 m limits, so the classes rank buildings relative to each other and do not measure their levels. The model is a radar surface of February 2000: it misses later buildings, roads, culverts and channel works, and it lifts older buildings off the ground.
